title: Crusoe reportedly raises $3B at a $30B valuation | TechCrunch
summary: Data center developer Crusoe, which counts Meta, Microsoft, and OpenAI as its customers, has raised a new $3 billion round at a $30 billion valuation, Bloomberg reported .
